title: AgenticX Official Website
description: The primary public digital platform and corporate gateway for AgenticX Knowledge Solutions (agenticx.co.in). Features dynamic course discovery, enterprise AI tracks, admissions workflows, and unified access to the AgenticX ecosystem.
features: Corporate showcase for AI & ML consulting, internship programs, and certifications.
Responsive, modern UI designed for desktop and mobile.
Integration with AgenticX centralized backend APIs for admissions and inquiries.

title: AgenticX Candidate Self-Service Portal
description: Dedicated self-service platform for candidates and interns (candidate.agenticx.in). Handles student onboarding, admissions, training track progress, Razorpay fee payments with webhook verification, and automated PDF receipts stored in Supabase.
features: JWT-based candidate authentication and role-isolated data access.
Razorpay live payment gateway integration with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification.
Instant admission fee receipt generation and storage.
Personalized learning track and training milestone tracking.

title: AgenticX Certificate Verification Portal
description: Public verification system enabling instant, tamper-proof validation of AgenticX-issued certificates (certificate.agenticx.in). Features automated digital signatures, JWT-signed cryptographic QR verification, and high-speed lookup.
features: Instant public validation by certificate ID or scanning QR code.
Cryptographic JWT-signed QR codes to prevent forgery and tampering.
ReportLab engine integration for verified PDF certificate rendering.

title: AgenticX All-in-One Central FastAPI Backend Engine
description: High-concurrency, asynchronous FastAPI REST engine serving the entire AgenticX ecosystem (api.agenticx.in). Houses 120+ endpoints, async SQLAlchemy ORM, Pydantic v2 validation, JWT role-based access control, Razorpay payment webhooks, and automated PDF engines.
features: Unified backend powering agenticx.co.in, candidate.agenticx.in, and certificate.agenticx.in.
120+ REST endpoints with async SQLAlchemy ORM and PostgreSQL.
Pydantic v2 schemas for robust request and response validation.
JWT-based role access control (admin and candidate scopes).
Production deployment on Render with Gunicorn and Uvicorn workers.
